blogs.title: The 4-Bit Revolution: How QLoRA Lets You Train Giant AI on a Single GPU
blogs.description: Explore how the new QLoRA technique shatters the barrier to entry for Large Language Model (LLM) development. We break down how compressing massive 65-billion-parameter models into just 4 bits allows researchers and hobbyists to fine-tune state-of-the-art AI on a single consumer graphics card, democratizing access to technology previously reserved for tech giants.

blogs.title: Meet Guanaco: The Open-Source Chatbot That Rivals ChatGPT
blogs.description: Discover the story of 'Guanaco,' the family of AI models created using QLoRA that reached 99.3% of ChatGPT's performance. This post analyzes the surprising results of fine-tuning on high-quality open data versus massive datasets, explaining how a smaller team built a competitor to industry leaders without spending millions on compute clusters.

blogs.title: Beyond Benchmarks: Why Your AI Might Be Smarter Than Its Score Suggests
blogs.description: Dive into the qualitative side of AI evaluation revealed in the QLoRA paper. We discuss why standard benchmarks like MMLU don't always predict chatbot success, analyze specific failure modes like math errors and 'secret-keeping' vulnerabilities, and debate whether using GPT-4 to grade other AIs is a fair replacement for human judgment.

blogs.title: Under the Hood: The Three Tricks Behind Efficient 4-Bit Training
blogs.description: A technical deep dive for developers interested in the mechanics of QLoRA. We explain the three key innovations that make this possible: NormalFloat (NF4) for optimal data distribution, Double Quantization to save space on metadata, and Paged Optimizers to handle memory spikes. Learn how these concepts turn theoretical compression into practical training pipelines.
